technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with stoch/AO bullish crosses offset by negative MACD, overbought conditions, and weak intermediate/long-term trend structure; insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 20 days present elevated risk with no offsetting fundamental or smart money support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (12/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 sale, 2 small purchases) and absent news sentiment provide weak confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (350+), flat yield curve, imminent NFP event, and earnings in 20 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for ACN trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Stochastic and AO bullish crosses with price above 9/21 EMAs offer short-term momentum entry, and extreme fear (12/100) presents classic contrarian opportunity near support at 282.58.
debate.key_bear_argument: Negative MACD histogram, stochastic overbought at 91.3, price below 200-EMA and 50-SMA, imminent earnings (20 days), VIX crisis regime (350+), and zero fundamental/smart money support create overwhelming headwinds that invalidate technical signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Stochastic and AO bullish crosses with price above 9/21 EMAs offer short-term momentum, and extreme fear (12/100) presents contrarian opportunity. However, overwhelming macro headwinds, imminent earnings (20 days), and zero fundamental support make this unsuitable for new entry.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis regime (350+) combined with earnings in 20 days creates binary event risk that invalidates technical signals; negative MACD and overbought stochastic (91.3) limit upside.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish macro/fundamental backdrop despite bullish technicals
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding ACN with 8 existing IT positions (20% sector concentration); adding to this position increases concentration risk during crisis volatility and earnings uncertainty.
